title: Show turns added in the agent runtime app in the o8 chat
summary: See turns you add to an o8 chat from the agent runtime app, on desktop or phone, in the o8 chat.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: See turns you add to an o8 chat from the agent runtime app, on desktop or phone, in the o8 chat. Requires Settings > Models > agent runtime app > Show chats in the agent runtime app, which stays off by default.
